newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: SKI JUMPING-GOLBERGER TEMPORARILY SUSPENDED FOR DRUG USE.
newsitem.headline: SKI JUMPING-GOLBERGER TEMPORARILY SUSPENDED FOR DRUG USE.

text.p: The Austrian ski federation (OSV) said on Monday it had temporarily suspended ski jumper Andreas Goldberger who has admitted using cocaine.
An OSV spokesman said the federation would decide what action to take against Goldberger after a hearing with the disciplinary board, which will be meeting "within the next few weeks".
Goldberger, overall World Cup ski jumping and ski flying champion in 1995 and 1996, told Austrian television ORF on Sunday that he took the drug at a Vienna disco a year ago.
Goldberger dismissed accusations he had regularly bought, sold and used large amounts of the drug. He said police had questioned him and searched his house but that no evidence had been found.
"I was curious and I tried it once. It was a big mistake," said Goldberger, who is immensely popular in Austria and was voted the country's spsortsman of the year in 1996.
OSV president Peter Schroecksnadel told the Austrian news agency APA he did not understand why Goldberger used cocaine.
"We have 240 youngsters in the squad. It is a big responsibility. Their parents should be assured that we are 100 percent dedicated to clean sport," said Schroecksnadel.
